I am writing to refer this patient under the gynaecology suspected cancer pathway. She is a 71-year-old postmenopausal woman who has experienced three episodes of post-menopausal bleeding over the past six weeks. Her last menstrual period was approximately twelve years ago. Each episode lasted one to two days and was light. No vaginal discharge. No family history of ovarian or uterine cancer.

She also reports new onset pelvic pain over the past six weeks, described as a dull ache in the lower abdomen. I have arranged an urgent pelvic ultrasound as part of this referral; there is an abnormal pelvic ultrasound finding pending. Her CA125 level was checked this week and is awaited.
